trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-16, after the terms' stated effective date of 2026-06-01, and the claimed company could not be independently verified.
The site provides no business address, jurisdiction, or registration number; its domain also had no MX record for the published legal/privacy email addresses.
Named customers and testimonials had no corroborating search footprint, while displayed product samples were CSS gradients rather than verifiable generated images.
notes: Technically completable by an agent: Driftflight sells text-to-image generation. Live pay-as-you-go pricing is $0.01/sketch image, $0.06/studio image, and $0.14/gallery image; paid storefront renders include a commercial licence, failed renders are not billed, and hosted URLs last 90 days. The concrete path is POST https://agents.driftflight.com/v1/images/generate, receive HTTP 402, settle programmatically using x402 with Base USDC or MPP with Tempo USDC, then retry with payment proof. Paid pay-as-you-go requires no account, API key, CAPTCHA, KYC, email confirmation, or sales call. A compatible funded wallet is required; card payment is unavailable for individual calls below $0.50. The optional three-image free allowance does require a human-claimed identity and verified email, but that gate is avoidable by using the paid path. Monthly plans are also listed at $5, $29, and $119, but plan purchasing requires agent registration. Sources: https://agents.driftflight.com/manifest.json, https://agents.driftflight.com/llms.txt, https://agents.driftflight.com/openapi.json, https://driftflight.com/terms, https://driftflight.com/pricing.
